headline: Lil Yachty and Ice Spice turned their latest music video into a full-blown jewelry showcas
body: Lil Yachty and Ice Spice turned their latest music video into a full-blown jewelry showcase, with ’s one-of-one pieces possibly being the biggest flex hidden in plain sight 💎 The visual is filled with diamond chains, watches, rings, pendants and custom jewelry in nearly every scene. However, the pieces standing out the most belong to the custom 1win collection worn by Ice Spice. These aren’t pieces anyone can simply walk into a store and buy, they were created as true one-offs. From the oversized diamonds and custom detailing to the instantly recognizable 1win design, the jewelry feels like more than an accessory it becomes its own character in the video 👀
